verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies user control over data lifecycle. Instances can be destroyed and cleaned up via the CLI, and persistent volumes survive instance destruction and can be managed on the Storage page and through the CLI and API. A low balance can also trigger instance deletion, which autobilling is meant to prevent. Missing for 10: any documented data-retention policy, guarantees that data is wiped from host machines after an instance is destroyed, account- or platform-level data deletion controls, configurable retention settings, and independent corroboration.
